basic.name: Fel Flame
basic.description: Release a wave of flame, dealing 210~~0.045~~ damage to enemies.

basic.name: Drain Life
basic.description: Drain the life from an enemy over 3 seconds, dealing 132~~0.04~~ damage per second and healing Gul'dan for 188~~0.04~~ Health per second.

basic.name: Corruption
basic.description: Call forth three bursts of shadow energy, dealing 204~~0.045~~ damage over 6 seconds. Corruption can stack up to 3 times on an enemy.

heroic.name: Horrify
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120~~0.04~~ damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

heroic.name: Rain of Destruction
heroic.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165~~0.04~~ damage in a small area.

trait.name: Life Tap
trait.description:
Gul'dan does not regenerate Mana.

Activate to restore 25% of Gul'dan's Mana.

trait.name: Life Tap
trait.description:
Gul'dan does not regenerate Mana.

Activate to restore 25% of Gul'dan's Mana.

activable.name: Teleport To Demonic Circle
activable.description: Instantly teleport Gul'dan to the Demonic Circle.

activable.name: Consume Soul
activable.description:
Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365~~0.04~~ Health.

Stores up to 3 charges.

activable.name: Healthstone
activable.description: Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

activable.name: Summon Demonic Circle
activable.description: After 1 second, create a Demonic Circle at Gul'dan's location.

level1.name: Pursuit of Flame
level1.description:
Quest: Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame without dying.

Reward: Permanently increase Fel Flame's area by 33%.

level1.name: Chaotic Energy
level1.description:
Increases the cast range of Drain Life by 25%, and Regen Globes heal for 50% more.

Quest: Gather 15 Regen Globes.

Reward: Basic Ability Mana costs are permanently reduced by 20.

level1.name: Echoed Corruption
level1.description:
Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Corruption.

Reward: After hitting 40 heroes, Corruption gains new functionality. After the third strike, Corruption strikes 3 times in the opposite direction.

Mythic Reward: After 85 hits, Corruption heals for 100% of the damage dealt.

level4.name: Health Funnel
level4.description: Drain Life's cooldown recharges 100% faster while it is channeling. If an enemy dies while under the effect of Drain Life, the cooldown is instantly refreshed.

level4.name: Improved Life Tap
level4.description: Increase the Mana restored by Life Tap to 40%.

level4.name: Consume Soul
level4.description:
Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365~~0.04~~ Health.

Stores up to 3 charges.

level7.name: Bound by Shadow
level7.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

level7.name: Curse of Exhaustion
level7.description: Drain Life deals 50% more damage and Slows the target's Movement Speed by 40%.

level7.name: Hunger for Power
level7.description: Increases Spell Power by 15% but reduces healing received from allies by 25%.

level10.name: Horrify
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120~~0.04~~ damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

level10.name: Rain of Destruction
level10.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165~~0.04~~ damage in a small area.

level13.name: Fel Armor
level13.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

level13.name: Harvest Life
level13.description: Drain Life heals for 75% more Health when used on Heroes.

level13.name: Dark Bargain
level13.description: Gul'dan's maximum Health is permanently increased by 40% but his respawn time is increased by 10 seconds.

level13.name: Healthstone
level13.description: Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

level16.name: Rampant Hellfire
level16.description: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

level16.name: Ruinous Affliction
level16.description: Corruption deals an additional 70~~0.04~~ damage on impact. If the enemy is hit by all three strikes, the third strike deals 242~~0.04~~ damage.

level16.name: Darkness Within
level16.description: Dealing 600~~0.04~~ damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Life Tap to cost no Health and grant Gul'dan 25% Spell Power for 5 seconds.

level20.name: Haunt
level20.description: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

level20.name: Deep Impact
level20.description: Rain of Destruction Slows enemies Movement Speed by 90% for 0.5 seconds.

level20.name: Demonic Circle
level20.description: Summon a Demonic Circle at Gul'dan's location. Activate to teleport Gul'dan to the Demonic Circle.
